annotations.title: Catch basin grate and frame finder (OPSD type, bearing check, load class)

description: Names the Ontario Provincial Standard Drawing for a catch basin inlet type, checks the grate bearing on the frame ledge against the NAAMM minimum, gives the range of bearing bar lengths that sit on the ledge, and lists the EN 1433 load class for the traffic.

bar_depth_in.description: Depth of the grate bearing bars in inches (0.75 to 6), for example 1.25 or 2.5.

inlet.description: square-flat = OPSD 400.020, General purpose frame and flat grate; square-dished = OPSD 400.010, Dished grate with an overflow path; square-v = OPSD 400.030, V grate; birdcage = OPSD 400.120, Birdcage grate; overflow-perforated = OPSD 400.110, Overflow flat grate with perforated openings; raised-circular = OPSD 400.070, Raised frame with a round grate; curb-inlet = OPSD 400.081, Curb inlet outside the roadway; curb-overflow = OPSD 400.090, Curb inlet overflow.

seat_mm.description: Width of the ledge the grate sits on, each end, in millimetres (0 to 300).

span_in.description: The same clear opening in inches.

span_mm.description: Clear opening between the frame ledges, in the direction the bearing bars will run, 100 to 3,000 mm. Give only one of span_mm, span_in. Default 500 mm.

traffic.description: pedestrian = A 15; private-light = B 125; public-light = C 250; road-commercial = D 400; industrial = E 600; extreme = F 900.

name: catch_basin_grate_and_frame_size_finder
